entries.note: Wang 2014 (PMID 24872026, Cancer Immunol Res 2;846) abstract quote verbatim. FDA review p.5 'Nivolumab did not bind to PD-1 from rodents or rabbits.' verbatim. No SCLC engagement read-out; untested holds.
FDA BLA 125554 PharmR PDF fetched; executive-summary sentence verbatim. No SCLC exposure-response vs model; untested holds. 240 mg SCLC label dose not re-checked.
Quote verbatim (incl. 'tumors models' sic). Status stands. Model string wrong: review says CT26 (with RENCA, 4T1, B16F10) was REFRACTORY to 4H2; active models were J558 myeloma, MC38, SA1/N.

Quote verbatim in PMC6563834 author MS; journal page 403 (title spells 'Antitumor'). Not 'same': model got anti-PD-L1 9G2 not the class; built after CheckMate 032; 'previous observation' = paper's own CHK1i arm, not clinic. comparison_stated -> false.

Wang 2014 abstract quote verbatim. FDA review p.2/p.6 already states monkeys lacked 'the autoimmune toxicity seen in clinical trials' (non-SCLC patients); under the context rule the SCLC cell still opens untested 2014.

Ready 2019 (PMID 30316010, JTO 14:237, epub 2018-10-11) quote verbatim; NCT01928394 results posted 2020-03-24 verified. Contra holds but year moves to Antonia 2016 (fatal pneumonitis on nivo 3 mg/kg + ipi 1; myasthenia death); monotherapy-only anchor is Ott 2017, not 2019.

missing: Safety: Ott 2017 KEYNOTE-028 (doi:10.1200/JCO.2017.72.5069; PMID 28813164) - pembrolizumab 10 mg/kg monotherapy in SCLC, one grade 5 treatment-related colitis. Class drug, SCLC, monotherapy; predates Ready 2019 and should anchor the year if combination arms are excluded.

Safety: the FDA 2014 PharmR itself states the model-vs-patient comparison (p.6: 'In patients receiving nivolumab, autoimmune disturbances are the most commonly reported adverse events ... no evidence of autoimmune disease was observed in the monkey toxicology studies'; p.2: 'Monkeys did not develop any clear signs of the autoimmune toxicity seen in clinical trials with nivolumab'). comparison_stated=true, model_filed=true, but patients are non-SCLC; record it on the 2014 safety entry as the class-wide contradiction already published before SCLC dosing.

Efficacy 2014: the filed surrogate model already contained non-responders (RENCA, 4T1, CT26, B16F10 'refractory to treatment with 4H2', PharmR p.~82); not a patient comparison, but the model string and note should say the filed model was 3 of 7 tumours responsive, not a uniform success.

Efficacy: Hiatt 2022 (doi:10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-22-1128, PMID 35920742) is the only SCLC-mouse paper found that dosed an anti-PD-1 surrogate in Rb1/Trp53 syngeneic mice (weak alone, potentiated by bomedemstat); abstract makes no model-vs-patient comparison, so it does not upgrade the cell, but the judgement should cite it as the class-matched model rather than Sen 2019.
rule_questions: Post-hoc model: Sen 2019 RPP mice were built after CheckMate 032 (2016) reported and reproduce the ~10% monotherapy ORR. The brief's 'same' requires a 'prediction' that agreed, and 'best model' = the one the class relied on; a retrodiction by a model the class never used fails both, so I scored untested. Needs an explicit rule.

Class membership: Sen 2019 dosed an anti-PD-L1 surrogate (10F.9G2) while patients got anti-PD-1. If the atlas treats the PD-1/PD-L1 axis as one class this is at most 'other' (agreement for a different-mechanism drug), never 'same'. I treated anti-PD-L1 as outside the class -> untested.

Comparison stated: Sen 2019 contains both the model result (Results) and the clinical ~10% ORR (Discussion background) but never juxtaposes them; 'consistent with the previous observation' points to the paper's own CHK1i experiment. Does co-occurrence in one paper satisfy comparison_stated? I say no.

Cross-indication safety: the FDA 2014 review states the monkey-vs-patient contradiction itself, in melanoma/mixed-tumour patients. Does a class-level tox model contradicted in another indication before the class entered SCLC open the SCLC safety strip as contra in 2014, or must the patients be SCLC (2016)? I applied the context definition -> 2016, with the 2014 sentence as corroboration.

Combination arms: Antonia 2016's fatal immune-related AEs were in nivolumab + ipilimumab arms (nivolumab at full 3 mg/kg in the pneumonitis death). Does a class drug given with ipilimumab count for contra (2016), or must the anchor be monotherapy (then Ott 2017 pembrolizumab, not Ready 2019)? I applied class-present -> 2016.

Model change without status change: if efficacy entry 2 becomes untested, the cell has two untested entries (2014 generic syngeneic, 2019 RPP). Whether a model change alone warrants a new strip entry is a figure-design decision the brief does not make.
